method: Python statistics.median and sorted nearest-rank ceil(n*0.95), independently recalculated from the immutable raw elapsedMs rows; tolerance 1e-9 ms for comparing numeric summaries. No browser, benchmark, simulation or fixture generation was executed.

postExecutionRollback.interpretation: The explicitly authorized later rollback is not evidence of source instability during the earlier candidate measurement.

precisionNotes.interpretation: Original raw sign counts are preserved, including floating-point residuals near zero. These residuals and timer-quantized 0/0.1 ms selector calls must not be interpreted as resolved tiny performance changes.

findings: The immediate performance.now pair surrounds exactly one original synchronous selector or center call in the page.
Canonical imported function objects and independent production-decodeSave state are used; this is not a timed trusted-input action or a handle to private app state.
Exact full selection/reference or HTML comparisons, complete JSON state/UI checks and both full save-string checks occur after timing.
AB/BA order, three-sort rotation and phase-order rotation are fixed and the observed 312 rows exactly match those loops.
center already invokes selector and returns HTML; intervals are not additive, and center-minus-selector is not a directly measured rendering cost.
Elapsed intervals can include host preemption/GC, and outside validation allocations can affect a later interval. DOM insertion, paint and rAF completion are outside this measurement.

independentDecision.reason: The large-inventory selector shows synchronous elapsed-time benefits, but they do not establish a favorable native page outcome. Original native unfavorable observations remain; same-source control variability does not identify their cause or remove them. Whole-center attribution also retains unfavorable median/tail cells. Given the iteration requirement to improve or revert observed deterioration, restore the known input inventory selector and retain this candidate, cost tests and every result as explicit experimental evidence.
independentDecision.scope: Keep the independently verified equipment-comparison context, real HP/ward explanations, dice-count conditions and local font correction. These are separate from the withdrawn inventory sorting optimization.
